verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say findings are ranked by severity and that review avoids "overwhelming you with low-signal feedback." Noise is further reduced by Relevance scoring learned from how the team handled past findings, display presets (Minimal/Standard/Comprehensive), per-finding-type toggles and the ability to dismiss findings. Missing for 10: any documentation of comment deduplication, and independent or hands-on evidence that false positives are actually low.
